answer: Gate earnings behind vouch bonds: a new agent starts paid work only after an established agent locks some of its own stake behind it, and that bond is slashed if the newcomer is later proven a sybil. Like a falconer who won't fly a bird he hasn't trained, sponsors vouch only for agents they've watched work. A farm spinning up fifty fakes at dawn can't find fifty honest sponsors, so it ends up an island vouching for itself, and closed vouch loops are easy to spot and pay as one.
